g.text: THE ISOLATION SPECTRUM: LATENCY, OVERHEAD, AND CONTAINMENT BOUNDARIES
• Large attack surface in QEMU C code
Key Architectural Invariant for Autonomous Agent Sandboxing:
Containers share the host kernel (rendering them vulnerable to privilege escalation), while legacy VMs take tens of seconds to boot.
MicroVMs (Firecracker) bridge the gap: sub-50ms cold boot, 5MB footprint, and true hardware hypervisor boundaries.
